profile.name: Timepix4探测器控制器
profile.description: 用于控制 Timepix4 像素探测系统的硬件控制器，可执行偏置电源开关、快门开闭与触发配置、计时器复位与同步，并读取本地/远端/FPGA 温度、湿度、压力及风扇转速等运行状态。适用于探测器上电准备、曝光控制和实验运行监测。
profile.description_en: A hardware controller for a Timepix4 pixel detector system. It manages the bias supply, shutter opening/closing and trigger configuration, timer reset and synchronization, and reads operating conditions such as local/remote/FPGA temperature, humidity, pressure, and fan speeds. It is used for detector preparation, exposure control, and runtime monitoring in experiments.
